Description: This file contains PDF copies of invoices, if available.

This file contains information about digital content you borrowed, including ASINs, titles, authors, content types (e-books, e-magazines), loan creation dates, loan status (borrowed, returned, expired), loan programs (Comixology, Kindle, and Public Library), return dates, email addresses if provided, and indicators for repeat loans.

This file contains detailed information about digital orders, including order date, ASIN, Title, order identifier, quantity ordered, order fulfillment date, price, seller name (for example, Amazon or Audible), whether it's a gift item, gift messages, billing and shipping address information, monetary transaction details including amounts and taxes paid, promotional discounts, and payment information such as foreign exchange rates and gift card usage.

This file contains transaction details of digital order returns and refunds, including Delivery packet identifier, order identifier, ASIN, Title, return status, return date, refund amount, condition (for example, unused or not downloaded), quantity, digital item identifier, price amount, tax, information on whether the return was initiated by Amazon or you, whether an email was sent to the customer, and any foreign currency exchange data if applicable.

This file contains information about the retail orders you placed, such as the website used to place the order, order identifier, order date, ASIN, Product name, quantity, price, product condition (New or Used), payment method (for example, credit card issuer name and last 4 digits of credit card), order status (for example, authorized, cancelled, or closed), ship date and option (for example, standard 2-day or next-day), shipping and billing address, carrier name and tracking number, if available, and if applicable, gift message, sender name, and receiver contact details.

This file contains retail order return and refund information including order and return order identifiers, return creation date, website used for the return, quantity returned, return status (for example, completed or cancelled), return reason, return amount status, direct debit amount if applicable, refund completion date, amount refunded, refund status, and disbursement type (for example, refund or disbursement).
This file contains the original order ID and the replacement order ID if a courtesy replacement order was placed.

This file contains information about the returns you initiated, such as order and return identifier, return request date, ASIN, Title, return reason (for example, wrong item, not required, etc.) and total quantity returned.

This file contains information about order returns including order identifier, date of return, return amount, return reason, resolution (for example, exchange or refund), return tracking information, return receivable details including tracking identifier and initiation date, return receivable creation reason (for example, instant refund or advanced refund), return state, and retrocharge information for returns in progress with resolutions such as advanced refunds or replacement orders.
